excerpts.exact_text: This Agreement may be terminated at any time prior to the Titanium Merger Effective Time by mutual written consent of the Company and Parent by action of their respective boards of directors.
the Parent Board shall have made a Parent Adverse Recommendation Change
the Parent Board shall have made a Parent Intervening Event Recommendation Change
there has been a breach or inaccuracy of any representation, warranty, covenant or agreement made by Parent, Titanium Merger Sub or Forward Merger Sub in this Agreement
the Company Board shall have made a Company Adverse Recommendation Change
the Company Board shall have made a Company Intervening Event Recommendation Change
there has been a breach or inaccuracy of any representation, warranty, covenant or agreement made by the Company in this Agreement
a permanent injunction or other Order which is final and non-appealable shall have been issued preventing or prohibiting consummation of the Mergers
shall not be available to a party whose failure to fulfill any obligation under this Agreement has been the cause of, or resulted in, the failure of the Titanium Merger to occur by such date
shall not be available to a party whose failure to fulfill any obligation under this Agreement has been the cause of, or resulted in or materially contributed to, such Action or event
such breach or inaccuracy or failure to be true would result in the failure to satisfy one or more of the conditions set forth in Sections ‎5.3(a)(i) or ‎5.3(a)(ii)
at any time prior to the receipt of the Parent Stockholder Approval
